# Voidix Minecraft Server

> Voidix is a free, non-commercial Minecraft server community in China. It provides minigame and survival experiences for Java Edition and Bedrock Edition players.

## Official website

- [Homepage and connection guide](https://www.voidix.net/): Server overview, supported editions, and connection information.
- [Server status](https://www.voidix.net/status/): Current server availability and player statistics. Real-time data is available only from networks that can reach the status service in mainland China.
- [Frequently asked questions](https://www.voidix.net/faq/): Joining instructions, version compatibility, rules, and common troubleshooting.
- [Bug reports and feedback](https://www.voidix.net/bug-report/): Official feedback channels for bugs and suggestions.
- [Privacy policy](https://www.voidix.net/privacy/): Information about data processing, cookies, and third-party services.

## Server addresses

- Minigame server: `minigame.voidix.net`
- Survival server: `survival.voidix.net`
